newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila SEC clears Mabuhay Vinyl IPO.
newsitem.headline: Manila SEC clears Mabuhay Vinyl IPO.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission said on Thursday it has cleared the initial public offering of Mabuhay Vinyl Corp, a chemical producer.
Mabuhay Vinyl plans to offer 223.187 million shares to the public at 2.38 to 3.18 pesos each, or at 12 to 16 times its projected earnings for 1997, the SEC documents showed.

Mabuhay Vinyl, a major producer of polyvinyl chloride (PVC) resin, plans to use the proceeds of the IPO to fund its 49 percent equity investment in Philippine Resins Industries Inc, a 70,000-tonne PVC resin plant in Bataan near Manila in a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corp and Tosoh Corp and Bank of the Philippine Islands.

The major stockholders of Mabuhay Vinyl are the Bank of the Philippine Islands, with 34.08 percent; Maria Christina Chemicals Industries Corp, 29.96 percent; Asian Investment Co Ltd, 12.83; Eastide Philippines Co Inc, 9.54 percent; and Mitsubishi Corp, 3.35 percent.
BPI Capital Corp is lead underwriter of the offer.
